notes.title: Dodge the Wall update v0.2.0 released
notes.notes:
Here's what's happening in the latest release of Dodge the Wall!

[list]
[*] By popular demand, music has been added to the game! Jam to the beat as you dodge those walls. The music can be toggled from the main menu at the start of the game. 
[/list]

Have any suggestions for walls you want to see in the game? Post a reply here, or let us know over at our [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DodgeTheWall/]subreddit[/url]!

notes.title: Dodge the Wall update v0.1.1 released
notes.notes:
Our latest update to Dodge the Wall has released! 

Latest Updates: 

[list]
[*] The biggest feature in this release is a new system of increasing difficulty. As you dodge more walls, the speed of the game picks up. 
[*] More walls have been added! 
[/list]

Let us know if you have any feedback, either here in the Steam Community or over at our subreddit at www.reddit.com/r/DodgeTheWall

notes.title: "Dodge the Wall!" has released into Early Access!
notes.notes:
So excited to finally be releasing "Dodge the Wall!" into Early Access! 

We're still early on in development, and as we continue to improve the game we're going to keep you all up to date on our progress. With that in mind, here are the feature enhancements that are in development/next up on our roadmap:

[list]
[*] [b]Combos & increasing difficulty[/b]: Currently the walls are coming at the player always at the same speed. We're working on a system of increasing the speed and difficulty of the walls as the player dodges more walls. 
[*] [b]More game modes[/b]: We're working on adding additional game modes that expand on the "basic" wall dodging premise
[*] [b]More walls! [/b] We're always working on adding new walls for you to dodge
[/list]

We're always looking for player feedback! If you have an idea for a new wall, spot a bug that needs fixing, want to share your own gameplay footage, etc., then we'd love it if you posted in the Steam Community or on our subreddit over at reddit.com/r/DodgeTheWall


Keep dodging those walls!
-The Space Dog XR team
